title: Unpaved Area Routine Inspection Checklist
description: Completed by Apron Supervisor or OM: weekly and after any triggering event. Submitted to OM.

footer.dateLine: Date: March 12, 2026. Maintenance Paved and Unpaved Manual.

items.text: Grass height measured at representative points within 20–38 cm range
No areas of grass exceeding 38 cm height anywhere in runway strip
No objects, debris, or non-grass items exceeding 7.5 cm height in cleared area
No significant depressions, mounds, or ruts > 7.5 cm in runway strip
No saturated or flooded zones in runway strip adjacent to runway edges
No wildlife nests, burrows, or significant bird/wildlife congregation observed
No unauthorized equipment, vehicles, or materials left in runway strip
Runway strip boundaries (fence / markers) intact and correctly positioned
RESA at Threshold 07 completely free of objects > 7.5 cm height
RESA at Threshold 07 ground surface level, no significant depressions or mounds
RESA at Threshold 07 no standing water; ground appears firm
RESA at Threshold 07 no soft spots or subsidence evident under foot-probe
RESA at Threshold 25 completely free of objects > 7.5 cm height
RESA at Threshold 25 ground surface level, no significant depressions or mounds
RESA at Threshold 25 no standing water; ground appears firm
RESA at Threshold 25 no soft spots or subsidence evident under foot-probe
Taxiway Alpha strip grass within acceptable height range; no objects > 7.5 cm
Taxiway Alpha strip no soft spots adjacent to taxiway shoulders
Taxiway Bravo strip grass within acceptable height range; no objects > 7.5 cm
Taxiway Charlie strip grass within acceptable height range; no objects > 7.5 cm
No saturated areas in taxiway strips that may undermine unpaved shoulder integrity
Turn pad surround at Threshold 07 free of FOD, loose aggregate, and objects > 7.5 cm
Turn pad surround at Threshold 07 no ruts > 7.5 cm from nose gear
Turn pad surround at Threshold 25 free of FOD, loose aggregate, and objects > 7.5 cm
Turn pad surround at Threshold 25 no ruts > 7.5 cm from nose gear
No unauthorized vehicles, materials, or structures in infield areas
No waste accumulation, debris piles, nesting material, or animal carcasses
No significant bird or wildlife congregation creating aviation hazard
No infield grass exceeding 50 cm height
All mapped Zone 7 areas no expansion of saturated zones beyond mapped boundaries
No new soft spots or subsidence identified outside existing Zone 7 map
No upwelling water or seepage from Zone 7 areas onto adjacent safety areas
No unauthorized vehicle entry into any Zone 7 restricted area
Zone 7 restricted zone markers/signage in place and legible
